english.title: Remove goods before a seal / lock / mark had been lawfully removed
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[wilfully removed goods,]_
(B)_[were in charge of goods wilfully removed,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), before a

(C)_[seal identifying or securing them]_
(D)_[lock securing them]_
(E)_[mark identifying them]_

was lawfully removed, the goods being

(F)_[in the United Kingdom]_
(G)_[within the limits of a port, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PORT..), in the United Kingdom]_
(H)_[on passage between ports in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PORTS..), ]_
(I)_[between a port in the United Kingdom and a port in the Isle of Man, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PORTS..), ]_

and the

(J)_[seal]_
(K)_[lock]_
(L)_[mark]_

being used to secure or identify those goods for the purpose of the customs and excise Acts in pursuance of those Acts or a requirement imposed by or under those Acts
english.legislation: Contrary to section 83(1)(b) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
